resources.string: Our own bridge library is loaded inside zygote through the native-bridge property and drives modules through the Zygisk API v4 table. This is the landing spike: one test module that only logs its pre/post calls. There is no companion (modules asking for one get -1), the PLT-hook and JNI-hook API calls report unsupported, 32-bit processes get no bridge, the system server path is not hooked, and the Magisk app\'s own Zygisk toggle still has no effect. Applies at the next full boot. Native-engine Android 6.0 (arm64) guests. Experimental.
